summary: The dataset toolbar's gear button now opens a Preferences window that also lets you choose which tab each kind of dataset or method window opens on.
details: Default number formats keep working exactly as before and are still shared with everyone using the same ArcRho Server.
The new Default Tabs section is yours alone and is remembered per project, so a colleague opening the same project keeps their own choice.
Each section says whether it is shared or personal and shows the file it writes to.
Reset to app defaults puts every window kind back to the tab the app opens on.
Opening an existing method now follows your choice; adding a brand-new one still starts on Details.
Windows now open straight onto the chosen tab instead of showing another one first and jumping.
Dataset and method windows stay blank until their opening tab is ready, so the contents appear in one step instead of being assembled on screen.
